config.calibration_rule: one threshold per detector and operating point: the higher-method (1 - alpha) quantile of pooled calibration easy-negative query scores across all transforms; a query is removed when its score strictly exceeds the threshold
config.claim_boundary: Synthetic collisions rendered natively at 224 px; full 24-frame clips compared with full training clips (curation setting). Results characterize detector behavior on provenance ground truth; they do not measure exposure effects and do not transfer automatically to the 64 px, 8-frame model inputs.

detectors.centroid_invariant: centroid tracks searched over mirroring and integer time offsets up to 3 frames (overlapping frames only)
detectors.centroid_motion: two-color foreground centroid tracks, negative RMS distance; extraction failure never matches
detectors.dinov2_aligned: DINOv2 frame embeddings, mean of time-aligned per-frame cosines
detectors.dinov2_aligned_norm: dinov2_aligned with the same background normalization
detectors.dinov2_pooled: DINOv2 ViT-S/14 CLS embeddings on native 224 px frames, mean-pooled, cosine
detectors.oracle_state: privileged state-distance reference: negative RMS state distance from simulator records (not a provenance oracle)
detectors.raft_flow: torchvision RAFT-small flow between sampled frames at native 224 px, 8x8 average-pooled field, cosine
detectors.raft_flow_invariant: RAFT flow descriptor searched over mirroring (grid flip, negated x-flow) and offsets up to 1 sampled step
detectors.raft_flow_norm: raft_flow with the same background normalization
detectors.silhouette: color-invariant 8x8 foreground occupancy per frame, negative RMS distance
detectors.sscd_aligned: SSCD frame embeddings, mean of time-aligned per-frame cosines
detectors.sscd_aligned_norm: sscd_aligned minus the query's mean top-10 similarity to 500 unrelated background clips (VSC-style score normalization)
detectors.sscd_pooled: SSCD sscd_disc_mixup frame embeddings on native 224 px frames, mean-pooled, cosine

hard_negative_band.construction: independent event conditioned on RMS state distance in [0.25, 0.5] x the target's nearest other-gallery distance (sensitivity-scaled box proposals, multiplier 6)

config.interpretive_gate: Conclusions about a perceptual detector on trajectory reuse require it to pass the copy_reencode positive control: AUROC versus easy negatives >= 0.95 and recall >= 0.80 at the 5% operating point. Detectors failing the gate are reported as not functional in this domain.
metrics: hard-negative (similarity-selected nearby) false removal per transform
AUROC positives vs easy negatives and vs hard negatives
top-1 source retrieval accuracy for removed positives
tie-aware (mid-rank) median rank and top-1 rate of the true source among gallery items
config.name: detector_benchmark_v3
config.outputs: results/detector_benchmark_v3.json (summary) and results/detector_benchmark_v3_scores.json.gz (per-query scores for frontier, bootstrap, and gate analyses by scripts/analyze_detectors.py)
config.purpose: Measure whether exact, perceptual, and motion-based duplicate detectors recognize same-trajectory rerenders under stress transformations while sparing independent and similarity-selected nearby events, at query-level false-removal rates calibrated on separate families.
config.query_score: maximum similarity over the full training gallery
registered_expectations: All perceptual detectors achieve high recall on the copy_reencode positive control.
Exact hashing has near-zero recall under every transform except none.

On appearance-changed rerenders, generic perceptual descriptors (SSCD, DINOv2) are far weaker than on copies, because trajectory identity is carried by small positional differences in visually homogeneous scenes.
Motion descriptors recover appearance-only rerenders; invariance search recovers mirror and time-shift recall at some cost in false removal.
Closer-than-gallery hard negatives produce higher false removal than easy negatives for motion and state-based detectors.
config.restart_note: First v3 launch was stopped at about 40% because it saved only summaries; restarted with identical configuration and seeds plus per-query score export.
config.size_note: Easy negatives reduced from 1000 to 600 per transform before running (native 224 px is ~3.8x slower); pooled calibration still uses 4,800 negatives.
config.supersedes: v2 rendered at 64 px. Upsampling to 224 px magnified JPEG blocks so that a re-encoded exact copy had median SSCD cosine 0.64 to its source, below a recolored rerender (0.94); the copy positive control failed, so v2 perceptual results are uninterpretable for trajectory claims. v2 also had a 1/64 mirror-mapping offset in centroid_invariant and an untied rank statistic. v3 renders natively at 224 px (no resampling for SSCD/DINOv2; RAFT at native resolution).

transforms.compression: appearance plus per-frame JPEG at quality 25
transforms.copy_reencode: positive control: the identical gallery render re-encoded as JPEG quality 75 (negatives: independent events, fresh appearance, same re-encoding)
transforms.crop: appearance plus central 80% crop resized to full resolution
transforms.distractor: appearance plus a third moving disk (radius and speed scaled with resolution)
transforms.texture: appearance plus a static random background texture
transforms.time_shift: appearance plus a 3-frame (0.12 s) temporal offset
